title: Prove optimal permutation column layouts with peak bond d² (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Every nonidentity permutation of equal-dimension sites has minimum exact matrix-product peak bond **d²** when the same arbitrary column order may be chosen for its input and output sites. Identity routing has optimum one. Claim type: scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration, produced by Nick Petalas.

For a prefix with c outgoing wires, the complete coefficient unfolding has rank d^(2c), with every nonzero squared singular value equal to d^(n-2c). An explicit wire-label tensor train attains every cut rank simultaneously. Consecutive directed cycles give the optimal order:

~~~text
permutation -> disjoint directed cycles -> concatenate cycles
each internal cycle cut -> one outgoing and one incoming wire -> bond d²
~~~

The half-swap of 2k sites therefore changes from peak d^(2k) in natural order to d² after interleaving. This resolves the algebraic layout escape left by zxv [#5441](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5441). Its physical-column contract, cut argument and original half-swap example retain their credit. Cycle decomposition, operator-Schmidt rank, tensor-network factorization and projection bounds are classical; global literature priority is unclaimed. No predecessor scientific executable is imported or replayed.

The seven new files in research/permutation-cycle-layout/ contain the proof, bounded construction, exact verifier and registered provenance. Canonical base is e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57, priority revision 8, selected #7000. The formal-interface-lemma card explicitly changes scope to this algebraic routing interface. [Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19595275).

## Evidence

Before, #5441 supplied the fixed-order exponential half-swap obstruction and warned that reordering changes it. The new theorem gives the exact optimum over simultaneous orders and the attaining representation.

Local CPython 3.12.15 on macOS 27.0.1 arm64 passes:

- 11,680 literal coefficient unfoldings, 694,400 nonzero entries and 164,014 stored Gram entries. Exact Gram identities certify the complete flat spectra.
- All 5,913 permutations through seven sites, with an independent all-order subset dynamic program using 695,482 subsets and 2,406,609 transitions.
- 64 explicit trains and 17,047 contracted physical entries, thirteen invalid-input rejections and seven semantic controls.
- Both warning-strict normal and optimized registered checks, metadata/source pins, and committed bytes, modes and source history. Each registered command was timed directly at 1.15 seconds against its 120-second limit.
- Official committed export integrity, followed by normal and optimized read-only Git-free replay with empty PATH and private bytecode-cache namespaces. Counts and all seven source hashes agree with local execution. Receipts are generated by the verifier.

Exact reproduction from the worktree root:

~~~sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/permutation-cycle-layout/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -O -B research/permutation-cycle-layout/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/permutation-cycle-layout
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/permutation-cycle-layout --check-source-history --check-modes
~~~

Another CPython 3.12 path may replace the absolute interpreter path. Expected markers are PASS_PERMUTATION_CYCLE_LAYOUT, PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE and PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The universal theorem rests on the written proof; executable checks cover the stated bounded instances. Formula/layout inputs are capped at 64 sites and dimension 16; materialized trains are capped at six sites and 64 virtual states per cut.

The order is an unrestricted algebraic choice. Physical permission, reorder preparation, restoration and the complete caller bill remain open. Position-dependent fixed-width trains do not establish a fixed finite transfer table uniform across widths. The approximation corollary is a necessary operator-error bound and a sharp single-cut Frobenius bound, with no attaining operator-norm or simultaneous-cut approximation claim.

No actual supplier, native/tape implementation, new kappa or complete multiplication theorem is supplied. The selected frontier and all five inherited assumptions remain unchanged. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. No selected cold replay, Lean or Docker run was performed. No required local package check is deferred solely to CI.

Overlap coverage includes complete cached open PR and Discussion scans, live handoffs, direct all-state recent account bodies, focused merged searches and all-main README searches. Sparse local-note coverage is incomplete; a separate closed-PR bulk refresh timed out. Arbitrary historical diffs and unpublished work are outside the coverage.

## Open next questions

- Bind a caller that permits this simultaneous cycle order and price both layout preparation and restoration.
- Construct one useful fixed finite transfer table uniformly across widths, including its schedule state and legal physical order.
- Specify a changed endpoint with side information or unequal dimensions before deriving its new optimum.

## Related open work

No open PR was identified proving this optimal permutation tensor-train quantity. Nearby routing contributions are distinct:

- [#7504](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7504) computes canonical padded-rotation Beneš switch bits. This result concerns coefficient-unfolding ranks and simultaneous site orders; its construction and formulas are not dependencies.
- [#7390](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7390) fuses two encoded CRT payload sorts under a physical radix contract. This result supplies no physical sort or comparison of its instruction counts.

The older Nick Petalas #6184 studies arithmetic chirp spectra, a different endpoint. Its formulas and construction are not used here.

The completion refresh inspected the seven other open account PRs created since the advance CLAIM: #7527, #7528 and #7531 through #7535. Their parity-suffix conditioning, Euclidean resolvent, shared-hub query dimension, source-count floor, orthogonal Schur residual and tensor-splitting quantities do not study permutation column-order bond. No additional related routing result or competing value was identified. No extra mathematical computation checked those results.

## CI notes

**CI did not certify this package.** At unchanged head b3c894aa14a9e191635ceab5cb8310d23cb431a5, [run 43467444862](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43467444862), [plan job 132030227155](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43467444862/job/132030227155), failed in Onboarding helper tests. I read the PR checks once and downloaded the job log. Exactly one of 760 tests failed, with 24 skipped:

~~~text
test_research_current_status.CurrentCiNavigationTests.test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record
FAILED (failures=1, skipped=24)
~~~

The AssertionError says that the required string make frontier7000-verify was not found in the CI verification document. I checked both files at canonical base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57: certificates/selected-result.json names make frontier7000-verify, while docs/ci-verification.md still describes #6030 and make frontier6030-verify and omits the selected command. This PR changes neither file. The package replay job was skipped because plan failed, so hosted CI certified no package checks.

I independently downloaded and inspected the plan logs for rohanarun's [run 42905094314](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42905094314), job 130140894651, and dillona's [run 42903313790](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42903313790), job 130134720799. Each has the same sole failing test, missing-command assertion and 760-tests / one-failure / 24-skipped summary. The job metadata binds those logs to the stated runs.

All local checks recorded above passed at the unchanged head. No fix commit, push, retrigger or workflow rerun was made. The maintainers retain the repository-level repair. Hosted package replay, independent human review and formal proof-kernel acceptance remain unclaimed.

## Merge danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: isolated. Seven new files in one opt-in research package.
